repo_grounded_facts.statement: Provenance label taxonomy (fixed vocabulary): FEMA-EFFECTIVE (verbatim from effective FEMA source — authoritative for flood elevations at the parcel); STATE-BEST (best state source where no FEMA-effective value exists); OBSERVED (measured by the authoritative sensor/network); MODELED (hydraulic/hydrologic/model output — only as good as model, inputs, calibration); FORECAST (modeled value projected into the future, plus forecast uncertainty); OWNER-SUPPLIED (property-owner provided — unverified until checked); DERIVED (computed from other values — inherits weakest input); UNAVAILABLE (explicit absence of data, never confused with zero or stale).
Engineering gate: 'A visualization layer must not silently become the source of truth for a regulatory or engineering claim.' Authoritative, computed, and visual products must be kept separate.

Bonebank elevation reference: FEMA FIS Table 9, Section A (RM 844.75) records BFE 369.1 ft NAVD88; LAG 377.2, FFE 382.5, and berm 379.8 ft NAVD88 remain owner-supplied. Arithmetic differences from that FIS reference are LAG +8.1 ft, FFE +13.4 ft, and berm +10.7 ft. Parcel applicability is NOT verified: the address and asserted surveyed centroid differ by ~6.4 km, and the effective FIRM layer has no usable BFE at the sampled point. Vertical RMSE 0.33 ft is QL2-class catalog context only — NOT a site survey accuracy claim. Horizontal CRS EPSG:2966; evidence status OWNER_SUPPLIED; human oversight required.

Coordinate discrepancy (unresolved): the independently geocoded address point for 13101 Bonebank Rd is 37.84589, -88.0051, while owner PTDT documents assert a surveyed centroid of 37.9035, -88.0007 — a ~6.4 km discrepancy. Reconcile against the certified elevation survey before using derived coordinates for any regulatory purpose.
FRE 702 (Daubert) admissibility is a legal determination made by a court — it is not a boolean computable in code. The repository forbids self-certifying compliance claims.
